steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Food spoilage is caused by microorganisms (bacteria, yeasts, moulds) breaking down food. | Key Fact: Bacteria are the most common cause of food spoilage and food-borne illness. | Key Fact: Yeasts cause fermentation, producing alcohol and carbon dioxide — useful in bread-making but spoilage in other foods. | Key Fact: Moulds grow as visible fuzzy patches and can produce harmful mycotoxins.

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from food spoilage & microorganisms, and one past-paper question.
